name: neumorphism
label: Neumorphism
css: .style-neumorphism { background: var(--slide-surface, #E7E5E4); width: 1080px; height: 1080px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 60px; position: relative; box-shadow: 8px 8px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), -8px -8px 16px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7), inset 2px 2px 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5), inset -2px -2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 20px; overflow: hidden; font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; } .style-neumorphism::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 80%, rgba(0, 102, 102, 0.03) 0%, transparent 50%); pointer-events: none; } .style-neumorphism .hook { font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--slide-text, #1E2938); line-height: 1.1; margin: 0; text-shadow: 2px 2px 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8), -1px -1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); letter-spacing: -2px; } .style-neumorphism .text { font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--slide-text, #1E2938); line-height: 1.3; margin: 0; opacity: 0.85; text-shadow: 1px 1px 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6); } .style-neumorphism .step { position: absolute; top: 40px; right: 60px; font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--slide-primary, #006666); opacity: 0.08; line-height: 1; margin: 0; letter-spacing: -4px; } .style-neumorphism .brand { position: absolute; bottom: 60px; left: 60px; font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--slide-primary, #006666); letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0; } .slide-code.style-neumorphism { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1E2938 0%, #2a3a4a 100%); box-shadow: 12px 12px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), -8px -8px 16px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1), inset 2px 2px 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1), inset -2px -2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3); } .slide-code.style-neumorphism .hook, .slide-code.style-neumorphism .text { color: #F1F2F5; text-shadow: 2px 2px 8px rgba(0, 102, 102, 0.3), -1px -1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); } .slide-code.style-neumorphism .step { color: var(--slide-primary, #006666); opacity: 0.15; } .slide-code.style-neumorphism .brand { color: var(--slide-primary, #006666); } .slide-insight.style-neumorphism { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1E2938 0%, #2a3a4a 100%); box-shadow: 12px 12px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), -8px -8px 16px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1), inset 2px 2px 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1), inset -2px -2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3); } .slide-insight.style-neumorphism .hook, .slide-insight.style-neumorphism .text { color: #F1F2F5; text-shadow: 2px 2px 8px rgba(0, 102, 102, 0.4), -1px -1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); } .slide-insight.style-neumorphism .insight-text { font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 48px; font-weight: 500; color: #F1F2F5; line-height: 1.4; margin: 20px 0; text-shadow: 2px 2px 8px rgba(0, 102, 102, 0.3); opacity: 1; contrast: 1.2; } .slide-insight.style-neumorphism .step { color: var(--slide-primary, #006666); opacity: 0.15; } .slide-insight.style-neumorphism .brand { color: var(--slide-primary, #006666); }
